Description of Change:
Schneider Electric launched the Altivar 61 and Altivar 71 variable frequency drives in 2005, setting new
industry standards for motor control performance, ease of use, and operational reliability. In 2016, the
remaining variable frequency drives will be released for the Altivar Process Family. Each Altivar Process
model has built on the established performance set by those drives more than 10 years ago, creating new
benchmarks for information management, energy efficiency monitoring, and process optimization.
Altivar Process drives have taken over the advanced high-performance drive role in the Schneider Electric
product range and now, the End of Commercialization process has been initiated for the Altivar 61 and Altivar
71 ranges. Schneider Electric will maintain full support of these products up to the End of Commercialization
date and seven years beyond. This ensures that users will continue to benefit from the reliable performance to
these drives until the end of their operational lives and we assist in their migration to our more advanced
Altivar Process drive range.
Altivar 61 drives will be available through normal order channels until December 31, 2016.
Note that this End of Commercialization announcement only applies to the 230 and 460 volt versions of those
drives. For support or questions regarding assistance with application discussions please contact your local
Schneider Drives PAE.
Inventory Disposition and Return Policy:
Use to depletion. Standard warranty applies. Ineligible for Stock Rotations. All sales are final.

Definition of Dates:
Last buy shall be the last date that we will accept a PO. This date shall take into account the lead time to build the
product as well as current inventory levels.
b. Product support shall be 1 yr beyond end of commercialization or last buy whichever the latter.
c. Availability date of new product is when the new products are expected to be orderable.
d. End of commercialization if made to stock; this date will be before the last buy date (taking into account the build
/ shipping lead time as well as current inventory levels). If made to order; this date will equal the last buy date.
Note: Our factories have limited capacities for products going obsolete. Product availability will be set on a first
come first serve basis.
